summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with hands on experience building integrated hardware and software robotics systems in ROS2, C++, and Python. Built a voice controlled, vision guided robotic arm on ROS 2 Humble with a Jetson and Arduino controller, and an object tracking turret combining Jetson based vision with an STM32 embedded controller, debugging real sensor, control, and firmware integration failures end to end. Comfortable working the full robotics stack on Linux, from PCB level embedded C to ROS2 motion planning with MoveIt and RViz.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration.
Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and Bluetooth to translate hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.
Built a voice-controlled, vision-guided pick-and-place system across a Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller linked via WebSocket.
Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2x speedup, 92 FPS) for visual servoing and dual ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and forward kinematic chains for a 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz models in ROS 2 Humble and Noetic.
Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on physical UR5e via UR ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability measured at <2mm over 10 trials.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending control commands to an STM32 over UART running FreeRTOS with mutex-coordinated tasks.
